title: Zero textures, zero 3D models. An AI wrote this entire jungle
title_candidates: A fully walkable jungle built by AI using nothing but code
Zero textures, zero 3D models. An AI wrote this entire jungle
What happens when you ask AI to build a jungle from scratch
No artist touched this world. Every tree was generated by code
One person and one AI prompt made this entire 3D jungle
caption:
A developer asked Claude to build a full 3D jungle with zero downloaded art. No textures, no 3D models, no pre-built pieces. Every tree, vine, and shadow was generated by code the AI wrote from scratch.

The result is a walkable world with real lighting and vegetation dense enough to feel like a finished game. A few years ago, building something like this would have taken a team of artists and weeks of work. Here it took one person and one prompt.
